description: This file defines a PHP class for connecting to and interacting with a Netezza database as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It extends a PostgreSQL driver, customizing it for Netezza-specific behaviors, including SQL queries for meta data, handling of data types, and absence of keys support.

classes.name: ADODB_netezza
classes.description: A class extending the PostgreSQL driver to support Netezza-specific database interactions.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_netezza
classes.description: A class extending the PostgreSQL record set to handle Netezza query results.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table, adapted for Netezza which lacks primary key concepts.
